# Ministry of Education, Guyana

> Central portal for Guyana's education system providing curriculum resources, student materials, and educational programs across nursery, primary, and secondary school levels.

The Ministry of Education Guyana serves as the government education authority, offering downloadable curriculum guides, textbooks, interactive assessment tools, and official announcements for students and educators. The site supports national examination standards including NGSA, CSEC, and CAPE qualifications.

## Key Topics

- Primary School Resources
- Secondary School Resources
- Curriculum Guides
- CSEC and CAPE Examinations
- Student Materials
- Educational Worksheets
- Nursery School Resources
- NGSA (National Grade Six Assessment)
- Examination Division
- Ministry Departments
- Georgetown
- Interactive Quizzes
- Guyana Education System
- Teacher Training
- Student Welfare Programs

## Student Learning Resources

- [Primary School Resources](https://www.education.gov.gy/web2/index.php/students-resources/primary-school-resources): Primary school curriculum materials including reading, mathematics, and exam preparation guides
- [Secondary School Resources](https://www.education.gov.gy/web2/index.php/students-resources/secondary-school-resources): Secondary school curriculum guides and textbooks for CSEC and CAPE examination standards
- [Nursery School Resources](https://education.gov.gy/web2/index.php/nursery-school-resources): Downloadable curriculum guides, textbooks, and worksheets for nursery school education
- [Exam Quizzes - MOE QuizMe](https://education.gov.gy/quizme): Interactive quiz platform for exam preparation and educational assessment across subjects

## Ministry Information & Support

- [Ministry of Education, Guyana Homepage](https://education.gov.gy/en): Homepage of Guyana Ministry of Education with primary and secondary school resources
- [MOE Contacts](https://www.education.gov.gy/en/index.php/moe-contacts): Directory of Ministry of Education departments, regional offices, and contact information
- [Departments](https://education.gov.gy/en/index.php/about-us/departments): Overview of Ministry of Education organizational structure and departmental divisions
- [Contact Us](https://education.gov.gy/en/index.php/about-us/contact-us-2): Contact information and office address for Guyana Ministry of Education in Georgetown

## News & Communications

- [Announcements](https://education.gov.gy/en/index.php/media2/announcements): Ministry announcements on school news, programs, teacher training, and registration updates
- [Newsletters](https://education.gov.gy/en/index.php/more/newsletters): Weekly newsletter covering education news, nutrition programs, and student welfare updates

## Optional

- [10/10 Word Challenge](https://education.gov.gy/en/index.php/more/10-10-word-challenge): Daily vocabulary-building educational program to enhance language learning skills
